title: Custom Youth Wrestling Singlets (2026)
verdict: Wooter is our pick for custom youth wrestling singlets in 2026. A club can order any number in youth sizes, the design is free, and a sizing kit lets kids try a singlet on before the order.
Cliff Keen is the established specialist, with a minimum of six. All Sports Uniforms offers DAWG singlets and rush production. Boombah is an option for clubs that already buy from it.

ranking.fit: Youth clubs and middle school teams that want singlets kids will wear, in sizes that fit them.
ranking.lacks: Three to four weeks. Order when the room fills up in the fall, not after the first tournament.

ranking.fit: Programs that want singlets made in Ann Arbor, Michigan, with men's, women's and international cuts.
ranking.lacks: A minimum of six on most custom products, and 3 to 5 weeks after art approval.

ranking.fit: Teams that want DAWG singlets from an online builder, with one and two week rush when the season is close.
ranking.lacks: Small orders of women's singlets carry a per-singlet fee.

ranking.fit: Teams already buying Boombah for other sports that want a sublimated singlet from the same maker.
ranking.lacks: Wrestling is a small part of what it makes.

why: Youth wrestling loses kids to the singlet. A new eight-year-old who is uncomfortable in a tight uniform may not come back, so fit and look matter more than at any other level.
Get sizes right with a sizing kit, and let the design be something kids like. Sublimation makes any pattern possible at no extra cost.
Where your association allows it, a two-piece uniform of a compression shirt and shorts is an alternative. Wooter makes both pieces.

criteria.name: Youth sizing
criteria.text: A range that covers the smallest wrestlers.

criteria.name: Comfort
criteria.text: Fabric and cut that kids accept.

faq.q: What size singlet for a 60 pound wrestler?
faq.a: Use the maker's youth chart by weight and height. A sizing kit is the surest way.
If your association allows the two-piece, it helps nervous beginners. Many clubs offer both.

faq.q: Do girls need a different singlet?
faq.a: A cut made for girls fits better. Ask for it when you order.
Yes at Wooter, where the minimum is one on most items.
Plan on three to four weeks from the day you approve the proof. Wooter offers rush production if you are short on time.
